experiment: architecture-V2 Stage0 focus-relative representation probe; distinct from Student v1/v2 and subject-clamp V2
source_plan: 02_方案设计/V2候选方案-隐式几何与焦点相对表示_Stage0验证.md

preprocessing.RGB: official VGGT load_and_preprocess_images(mode=crop), PIL bicubic; no crop/padding for this aspect ratio
preprocessing.GT: nearest pixel center mapping floor((i+0.5)*native_size/output_size); no averaging depth or labels; same coordinate map for VDA
preprocessing.valid: raw finite positive axial Z only; no old Z<70 cutoff; no official transparency/mixed-pixel validity available

focus.rule: fixed RGB image coordinates, no GT/model selection; invalid focus skips that problem without substitution; not object tracking
focus.reference: median original native Z over mapped focus box intersect finite-positive validity; labels at nearest-resampled native points

labels.epsilon_selection: fixed 10 percent depth-ratio tolerance a priori, inspect training counts only before final freeze; no dev selection
labels.formula: r=log(Z_focus/Z); near r>epsilon; similar abs(r)<=epsilon; far r<-epsilon

boundary.rule: 3x3 max(logZ)-min(logZ)>log(1.1) at valid label grid; dilate3x3 once; no label smoothing

context.reason: fixed bounded five-frame probe before any dev feature/results; not a claim 25 frames cannot fit
context.P0: same five RGB frames: concatenate individual DINO patch feature with group same-position mean feature, no learned temporal module
context.P1: existing VDA 25-frame context, native windows32 overlap10 and padding; system reference not isolated representation comparison
context.P2_P2plus_P3: identical single VGGT forward and five-frame groups

VGGT.feature: concat frame/global spatial tokens at layer17; remove camera+4 register tokens; [B,S,P,2048]→[S,2048,16,37]
VGGT.depth: official depth_head exp activation, positive camera-axis depth; common unknown scene scale; no GT focus used
VGGT.precision: BF16 aggregator, official FP32 depth head
VGGT.enabled_heads: aggregator and depth only; camera/point/track disabled, report included and full checkpoint parameters

P0.encoder: DINOv2 ViT-L/14 reg4, independent official visual-pretraining weights
P0.implementation: same VGGT vendored DINO architecture, strict state_dict load; final normalized spatial patch tokens; no geometry fine-tuned VGGT encoder weights

P1.score: existing sequence-normalized float disparity minus median predicted disparity in same focus box; positive=near, no inverse-distance conversion
P1.calibration: train-source-equal Macro-F1, fixed symmetric thresholds; ties choose smallest; no dev fitting

P2.score: log(median(predicted depth in focus box)/predicted depth(x)); no GT focus

P2plus.input: log predicted VGGT depth at patch centers minus per-frame median log predicted depth; 1 channel; no RGB/tokens/GT

P3.input: only fixed layer17 spatial tokens plus focus mask

head.interaction: [projected pixel, masked-mean focus query, signed difference, product]
head.output: patch grid logits bilinear align_corners=False upsample to224x518 for ALL learned groups
head.focus_pooling: area downsample common display mask to16x37 for overlap-weighted mean
head.feature_normalization: P0/P3 per-token channel L2 norm times sqrt(C), parameter-free; P2+ centered log depth, no one-channel LayerNorm

training.loss: weighted cross entropy; weights inverse sqrt training pixel class frequency, normalized mean1
training.schedule: same pre-saved train question permutations for all3 heads; 8000 exposures per group
training.checkpoint: fixed final step1000 only; no dev checkpoint selection
training.precision: FP32 probe training; all pretrained parameters frozen

evaluation.primary: Macro-F1 computed from confusion pooled per source then source-equal mean
evaluation.secondary: Balanced Accuracy, fixed3 class recall mean
evaluation.absent_class: precision/recall/F1 denominator0 =>0; always divide by3, also report support
evaluation.focus_switch: all10 unordered pairs of five focus masks per frame; on GT-changed valid pixels report prediction-change rate and both-endpoints-correct rate, per source
evaluation.visualization: all6 sources frame1/13/25 and focus index1 fixed before results; preserve poor sources

limitations: six Sintel sources only; previously used development material, not blind test
foundation training exposure not audited; finite-positive validity does not remove all transparency/mixed pixels
P0 context mean is parameter-free and not geometry-aligned; backbone costs differ
P1 uses longer context and different preprocessing, cannot isolate representation advantage
boundary metric is not thin-structure accuracy
no Bokeh generation and no automatic Stage1

audit_intervention.why: Training-only input audit confirms sampled depth loss and area weights on centers outside focus; not chosen by new dev/independent performance
audit_intervention.unchanged: architecture41475 parameters, all optimizer/loss/seed/init/batch1000-step budget/data/focus/GT settings
audit_intervention.linked_effects: grid removes center decimation, makes focus-mask pooling exact on display pixels, removes patch-logit interpolation; these are linked effects of one spatial-grid change, not separately identified causes
